prompt: In a busy airport terminal, a row of check-in desks stretches along a polished floor beneath a large digital departure board. Luggage trolleys line up beside clusters of waiting seats occupied by passengers checking passports and boarding passes. Nearby, a security line snakes through metal barriers toward an X-ray machine and a passport scanner at a compact checkpoint. A pilot in uniform chats with a flight attendant under overhead signage directing travelers to gates, while a coffee stand emits the aroma of fresh espresso next to a magazine rack and a trash receptacle. At the far end, an escalator rises toward upper levels, and a row of glass sliding doors opens onto taxiways beyond a panoramic window. A wheelchair is parked near a charging station, and a baby stroller stands beside a vending machine and an information kiosk. A turnstile gate controls access to the boarding area. There is no skateboard, no bicycle, no scooter, no train tracks, and no surfboard.
